text:
PagerDuty Bot: [P1] Private VPC peering -> redwood-prod-eu-west1: high error-rate, 500s for customer ACME, triggered at 1964321000
Maria L.: acknowledged, jumping on now. paging network & infra.
Maria L.: initial symptom: app logs show DNS resolution timeouts to privatelink endpoints, followed by TCP connect failures.
Network Bot: Observability: packet loss spike on interconnect path eu-west1-az3 -> eu-west1-az1 between 1964320950-1964320980. BGP flaps detected.
Ajay K.: is this the peering on direct-connect or cloud-interconnect? which provider?
Kevin S.: ACME is on GCE interconnect + our PrivateConnect (L3). Looks like next hop AS path changed, some routes suppressed.
Sophie R.: customer reports intermittent 502s and timeouts over the last 3 mins. They're seeing failover to the public endpoint but app still errors.
Maria L.: running quick checks: `gcloud compute routes list --filter=\"network:acme-vpc AND nextHopRegion:eu-west1\"` -> results look odd, some routes missing.
Ajay K.: pulling BGP state from routers: `show ip bgp neighbors 10.10.2.1 received-routes | include acme-prefix` -> many prefixes withdrawn, localpref oscillating.
Network Bot: BGP neighbor 10.10.2.1 (ACME-interconnect) flapped 6 times in last 2m, local-pref shifts from 200 -> 100 observed.
Maria L.: lower-level check — cloud provider reports transient maintenance on eu-west1-az3 networking fabric. Opening ticket with GCP. @Sophie R. can you DM ACME and let them know we're investigating?
Sophie R.: on it. sending initial heads-up: "We see packet loss on interconnect in eu-west1, investigating. Will update within 15m." :phone_off_hook:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident acknowledged by Maria L. (on-call). ETA to escalate to ENG-NET: +2m if no fix.
Ajay K.: trying mitigation: reroute ACME traffic to our backup interconnect via eu-west2 region by advertising more specific /24 with higher local-pref to backbone. Preparing patch: `bgp advertise 198.51.100.0/24 localpref 300`
Kevin S.: we need to coordinate with cloud provider before we withdraw primary routes; risk of split-brain traffic. I've opened GCP support case 987654321.
Cloud Support Bot: Case 987654321 created with priority P1. GCP notes: investigating fabric issue in eu-west1-az3, may take 10-30m.
Maria L.: timeline: if fabric not recovered in 10m, we fail traffic to eu-west2; otherwise wait for provider fix.
Ajay K.: executing prep steps for failover. will apply BGP advertise in 2m window and monitor.
Network Bot: preflight checks OK: backup paths available, no AS path loops anticipated.
Sophie R.: ACME confirmed impact: "We see high latency and errors on checkout, traffic 35% dropped." They asked for ETA and if there's any customer-visible mitigation.
Maria L.: @Ajay K. go ahead with controlled failover now. We'll update ACME immediately once we see improvement.
Ajay K.: applying route announce now. `bgp announce 198.51.100.0/24 localpref 300` -> announced.
Network Bot: New path announced, advertised to backbone. Expected convergence ~30s.
Kevin S.: ping tests to privatelink IPs over backup path: initial 200ms -> now 32ms, packet loss 0%.
ACME Ops: seeing immediate drop in 500s, requests trending to 200s. Good so far.
Maria L.: monitoring application errors and logs. early signal looks positive. rolling back announce after provider confirms? No, keep backup active until stable.
Cloud Support Bot: GCP update: fabric issue in eu-west1-az3 confirmed; engineering mitigating. Estimated recovery 25-40 minutes.
Sophie R.: telling ACME: "We routed your traffic to backup interconnect (eu-west2) to restore service. GCP is working on the az-level fabric; we'll keep traffic on backup until they confirm repair."
Ajay K.: adding temporary DNS TTL bump on privatelink CNAMEs to reduce flapping impact: `dig +short privatelink.acme.internal` then update zone TTL to 300 -> was 60.
Maria L.: good. create incident ticket in jira: INC-4729, add timeline and customer updates.
Kevin S.: monitoring: 10m post-failover: error rate down to baseline, latency stable 30-45ms.
Maria L.: handoff to Ajay for next 2 hours while I take notes and manage comms. @Ajay K. you own mitigation and rollback plan.
Ajay K.: taking over. will keep team updated every 15m or on any change.
PagerDuty Bot: Handoff recorded: Maria L. -> Ajay K. at 1964321400.
Sophie R.: logged customer postmortem meeting for 1964325200 (2h out) with ACME to review impact & runbook.
Network Bot: will continue to poll BGP and fabric events; posting alerts if any further flaps.
ACME Ops: Thanks team. Please confirm when primary path restored so we can revert things on our end if needed.
Maria L.: noted. We'll coordinate revert with GCP and confirm with you before any change.
Kevin S.: adding follow-up action items: 1) validate TTL/route change rollback runbook 2) verify monitoring alert thresholds to catch early fabric regressions 3) test failover in DR runbook.
Maria L.: thanks all — incident remains open but mitigated. Updating incident channel and will publish full postmortem after provider confirmation and internal RCA. :white_check_mark:
